messages:
Alex Kim: Ran nsys profile on the canary after the kernel-select refactor. P99 latency up ~12% on short (<=64) sequences. Trace uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/traces/2008456789/nsys_trace.qdlt

Maria L: Which model/arch and exact workload? short prompt vs chat streaming?

Alex Kim: 7B opt-style, int8. Repro with local harness: batch=16, avg seqlen=40, streaming disabled. Command I used:
```nnsys profile -o trace.nsys --trace=cuda,cudnn --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi -- python perf_harness.py --model redwood/7b --batch 16 --seqlen 40
```

Kevin P: Looked at the GPU timeline: kernels named "matmul_small_kern_v2" are being picked by selector much more frequently. Previously "matmul_small_kern_v1" was used. v2 has worse occupancy for tiny N so it increases per-token cost.

Gabi R: Also confirmed KV cache hit rate dropped on the shared-prefix benchmark. Hit% went from 87% -> 61% after the batching heuristic change. That explains extra device memory traffic + more kernel launches.

Alex Kim: Quick nsight telemetry snapshot:
```
GPU time total: +9.8%
Kernel launch count: +18%
KV lookup latency (median): 1.2ms -> 2.9ms
```

Maria L: Any sign of cache-key churn? maybe the new batching merges prefixes and forces reinsertions causing evictions.

Gabi R: I dumped prefix access traces (first 10k ops) and saw hot prefixes reinserted repeatedly. Eviction rate spiked when the retention window shrank due to the slot-aligned batching tweak.

Kevin P: Reproducer: toggle env REDWOOD_BATCH_BUCKET=slot vs old. With slot the selector maps many short seqlens into bucket that picks v2. Boundary shift is the root cause.

Alex Kim: Short mitigation: force selector override to prefer v1 for seqlen <= 64 on canary. Applied patch. Early numbers show P99 back to baseline.

perf-bot: @here Canary deploy 1234 rolled back; selector override applied by Alex Kim :white_check_mark:

Maria L: Next steps: add microbench comparing v1 vs v2 across M/N/K grid, export occupancy + sm_efficiency, and add CI regression test that runs shared-prefix KV hit-rate check.

Gabi R: I'll attach a perfetto flame and the CSV of prefix access samples to the bug. Links will be posted in this thread.

Alex Kim: Thanks — I'll open the PR to revert the bucket boundary and add tests. cc @Kevin P for kernel perf graphs.

Kevin P: Will synth graphs and post in #eng-runtime later today :chart_with_upwards_trend:
